headline: Last session: Sensex gained 308 points to settle at 74,459 while Nifty reclaimed the 23,000 level.

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Tuesday, 3 November.

why: Nifty reclaimed the 23,000 mark during the last trading session on Friday
Coal India reported a 19% increase in production as mining recovered post-monsoon
Affle 3i announced an all-cash deal to acquire Israel's Perion Network for $420 million
Market sentiment improved as Sensex settled higher at 74,459.53 in the previous session
whatHappening: Nifty 50 gained 116.35 points or 0.51% to finish the last session in the green
Coal India's mining operations are recovering significantly after a monsoon-related slump
Affle is pursuing an international expansion through a $420 million acquisition of Perion Network
Analysts are identifying a resistance level at 23,200 for the Nifty in the upcoming trading week
summary: In the last session, the Sensex gained 308 points to close at 74,459.53, while Nifty reclaimed the 23,000 mark. Coal India reported a 19% production jump, and Affle announced a major $420 million acquisition. The market is currently closed for the weekend and will reopen on Tuesday.
